correctness.rationale: Affine invariance reduces to the unit square with only opposite arm pairs potentially nonvisible. Their segment enters the removed northeast quadrant iff XV>UY for four independent uniform coordinates; two products of unit uniforms give a bilateral Gamma(2) difference, leading to exact piecewise-logarithmic profile B=2q^2/(1-q)^2 Psi(st/q). For fixed deleted fraction q, AM-GM maximizes st uniquely at s=t=1-sqrt(q); strict increasing/concave Psi yields optimal stability coefficient K(q), and the arm-area bound gives B<1/2 with limiting sharpness. Independently integrated the crossing probability for five notch parameters to approx 1e-12; sampled sharp stability over seven q values; continuum proof analytical.
